unsigned_authorization.owner_instruction: «نسخه رو منتشر کن» (2026-10-31), after reading docs/releases/v1.0.12-fa.md
unsigned_authorization.why: The repository secret VIRA_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY cannot be created by the GitHub App token used here; every 1.0.x release so far shipped unsigned.
unsigned_authorization.unchanged_protection: The dated-token guard still fails closed on any other value, and SHA-256 is verified for every asset and for SHA256SUMS.txt. Signature enforcement starts with the first release built after that secret exists.

scope: item 1: delete an unused warehouse item, deactivate a used one with a security event
item 2: production/OUT movements no longer rewrite the item unit price
item 3: grams and print hours removed from the order page and schema
item 4: «اضافه به خط تولید» plans one job per unbuilt order line
item 5: finishing is refused when a spool cannot cover the job (no partial deduction)
item 6: multi-filament jobs from the additive 0007_production_filaments migration
item 7: order lines only from active warehouse PRODUCT/PCS items, with shortage warnings
item 8: pricing starts blank, computes only after entry, nothing stale restored
item 9: in-app step guides for new entry, receipts and bank statement import; the bank page now really stores the file
item 10: inventory-value card and the stock-value chart removed (5 KPIs, 3 charts)
item 11: the entry form is an invoice; بدهکار/بستانکار, account pickers and auto-balance left the user path while the server keeps the balanced ledger
defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_cycle: POST /journal-entries/invoice ignored Idempotency-Key, so a double click or a retried request could post two entries for one paper invoice; the route now claims the key like the other mutations and the retry replays the stored entry (409 on key reuse with a different body).

User-facing quantities printed in exponent form («موجود 2E+1 گرم») because Decimal.normalize() renders 2E+1; money.plain_number() is now used in the spool refusal, the order shortage warning and the print shortage message.

The pre-tag CI run was red for three reasons, all fixed: pip-audit found seven CVEs in pypdf 6.21.2 (lock upgraded to 6.21.4), update_native_smoke.seed_business and e2e/dashboard-audit still ordered free-text product names, and the pricing smoke asserted report rows before typing anything.
The dashboard e2e audit still expected the removed inventory-value KPI and the operations audit expected the old «موجودی کافی نیست» wording.
